title: Merge PR #203 (dividend foreign-withholding column removal, issue #202) + address CodeRabbit nit
description:
PR #203 (branch fix/dividends-0029-withholding-note) is OPEN, all CI green (test/codecov/GitGuardian pass, CodeRabbit reviewed, 0 actionable). Closes issue #202. Removes the 'Retención EUR' column from the Casilla 0029 detail card + adds a localized redirect note (5 locales) in the 0029 card and main.ts dividends table, gated on withholding>0. Foreign withholding stays in the Casilla 0588 card. Presentation-only; 0029/0588 totals unchanged. 1286 tests pass.

ACTION: decide merge (would be a patch release v0.47.2). One minor CodeRabbit nit to optionally address first: gate the note on the NET withholding total (groups.reduce sum > 0) rather than some(g.withholdingTotalEur>0) — minor because withholdingTaxEur is stored .abs() upstream so they're effectively equivalent today. Needs user merge approval (standing rule: never merge without explicit OK).

title: modelo720/721/d6 getEcbRate on year-end positions can throw for a crypto position in an unfetched year
description:
Pre-existing, surfaced (but out of scope) during the v0.47.1 ECB fix (PR #204). The modelo720/721/d6 generators call getEcbRate on OPEN POSITIONS at year-end (a separate flow from the cashTransaction income path that PR #204 fixed). For a crypto/FCY position whose year-end rate was never fetched (e.g. resolvable-but-unfetched, same class as the USDT income bug), getEcbRate throws and could crash that generator.

Not on the main report path; the modelo720/721/d6 calls in main.ts are wrapped in try/catch and Binance emits openPositions=[], so it didn't surface in the adrian report — but it's a latent crash for other broker/position combos.

FIX DIRECTION (mirror PR #204): gate these getEcbRate calls on lookupRateInMap !== null and degrade/warn instead of throwing; and/or ensure the years-to-fetch set covers open-position year-end dates. Audit all getEcbRate call sites in src/generators/modelo720.ts, modelo721.ts, d6.ts and the section-*.ts web counterparts.

Source: code-reviewer flagged this as a non-blocking follow-up while verifying PR #204.
